app.title: Penumbra — Exoplanet Analytics
app.summary: A person narrows a cleaned catalog by discovery-year range and discovery method in a sidebar. They then read headline counts and the method mix, discovery counts per year overall and for the top methods, and log-scaled scatter plots of property pairs coloured by method. Next they read a fixed table comparing two method groups, and the held-out results of a regression model: overall error metrics, actual against predicted values, feature importance and error broken down by method. Finally they pick one catalog entry to see its properties and, when it is in the test set, its predicted value and error.

task.text: Explore and summarize a filtered observational catalog by how its entries were found, and check a regression model's held-out predictions overall, by group and for single entries.

data.text: A cleaned catalog table with one row per object, giving physical and host properties, discovery year and discovery method, plus precomputed model outputs: held-out predictions, feature importances and a metrics file.
data.item: one cataloged object (a confirmed planet) with its properties and, if held out, a predicted value

stage.text: presenting a finished catalog analysis and model evaluation, after the cleaning, testing and modelling notebooks

mechanism.text: Sidebar filters for year range and method feed every catalog view in a set of tabs: summary numbers, bar and line charts of counts, log-log scatter plots coloured by method, and a single-entry lookup. The model tab stays tied to the fixed held-out set and shows metric numbers, an actual-vs-predicted scatter with an identity line, an importance bar chart and an error-by-group table.

field.text: population statistics and mass regression on an observational exoplanet catalog in astronomy

workflow.name: summarize a filtered catalog and check a model's held-out error

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: a discovery-year range slider and a multiselect of discovery methods narrow every catalog tab, but not the model results

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: counts of entries, hosts, methods and year span, plus a bar chart of the most common discovery methods

steps.step: summarize counts over time by group
steps.here: line charts of discoveries per year, overall and for the five most common methods in the filter, with the peak year stated

steps.step: compare groups across pairs of properties
steps.here: log-scaled mass vs radius and period vs temperature scatters coloured by method, with hover names, and a fixed table of medians and effect sizes for the two largest methods

steps.step: check a computed model against held-out data
steps.here: R², log MAE, median multiplicative error and share within a factor of 2; actual vs predicted log mass with a perfect-prediction line; feature importance; mean error per method
a selectbox of filtered entries shows its radius, mass, period and temperature, a row of host details, and its cataloged vs predicted mass if it was held out

distinctive: the train/test split is grouped by host system, so the model's error is shown only for entries whose whole system was held out
model error is broken down by discovery method, so selection effects in the catalog show up as differences in prediction error
heavily skewed properties are plotted on log axes, with non-positive and missing values dropped first
captions warn that group differences come from discovery selection effects and are not causal
